reason: Follow the bone-cell lineage first, as the chapter suggests, before assembling mature bone.

alternatives.reason: Mineralizing the collagen framework also seems relevant, but I want to establish the cell lineage first.

effect: The lineage now shows osteoblasts producing matrix and some becoming embedded osteocytes; next I can assemble the mature bone framework.
reaction: The transition from matrix-producing cell to embedded cell is interesting, though the precursor terms are unexplained.
reason: Mineralizing the collagen framework is the only offered combination and fits the goal of building supported bones.
expectation: Calcium phosphate will join the collagen framework to form mineralized arm bones; I am unsure what the result will be called.

effect: The framework now combines tough collagen with mineral that resists compression; it is ready for the bone cells.
reaction: The contrast between flexible fibers and firmer mineral makes their different roles clear.
reason: Adding bone cells is the only offered combination and fits the goal of assembling living bone.
expectation: The osteocytes will be incorporated into the mineralized framework, producing a mature bone cutaway.

effect: The cutaway places connected bone cells within the mineralized matrix; adding vessels is the next available step.
reaction: The tiny channels make it clearer how cells stay connected inside hard bone.
reason: Blood vessels are the only offered combination and should help supply the living bone cells.
expectation: The bones will gain a vessel network that supplies their cells with nutrients.

effect: The vessels supply nutrients through the channel network while blood cells remain inside them; the bones are ready for joint assembly.
reaction: The cutaway clarifies how embedded cells receive nutrients.
reason: Adding cartilage is the only offered combination and should prepare the bone ends to move at the elbow.
expectation: Cartilage will cap the bone ends at the elbow, providing smoother joint surfaces.

effect: Cartilage now covers the facing bone surfaces and allows them to slide; the next step is assembling the joint capsule.
reaction: The sliding inset makes the cartilage's role easy to visualize.
reason: The synovial capsule is the only offered combination and should enclose the developing joint.
expectation: The capsule will surround the elbow joint, with its lining and fluid shown in a cutaway.

effect: The capsule now encloses the joint, and its lining supplies fluid that helps the surfaces glide.
reaction: The connection between the lining, fluid and gliding is clear.
reason: Adding ligaments is the only offered combination and should support the elbow joint.
expectation: The ligaments will span the elbow and help stabilize the joint while allowing movement.

effect: The ligaments complete the supported elbow, allowing bending while resisting sideways movement; the chapter goal is complete.
reaction: The arrows make the distinction between mobility and stability clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Mineralizing the collagen framework was most worthwhile: the planned inset and prose connect collagen's toughness and mineral's compression resistance to bone structure.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding cartilage was straightforward but less engaging as a decision because it was the only offered combination, although the sliding inset clarified its role.

surprise.text: Some matrix-producing osteoblasts become embedded osteocytes, connected through tiny channels; the lineage picture made living bone more interesting than a static framework.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked an overall purpose, but the mesodermal and mesenchymal precursor terms appeared without explanation, making that part of the lineage harder to follow.

continue.text: I would continue: the connections between living bone, its material properties and joint movement make me curious how the next construction builds on them, despite the mostly forced sequence.
